svg.title: Drude current approaches a steady value and relaxes after switch-off
svg.desc: A field E0 switched on at time zero gives J/(sigma0 E0)=1-exp(-t/tau) from zero initial drift. A different switch-off experiment starts at the steady current and gives exp(-t/tau). After switch-off the field is zero; E0 is the field before switch-off. In both panels time zero is that panel's switching event, E0 is positive and n, mass and transport time are constant.
svg.text: Current builds up and relaxes on the transport time
Time starts at each switch; in (b), E0 is the field before switch-off.
